detail.longDescription: On the whole "went rogue" coverage: "OpenAI developers optimized an LLM specifically for cybersecurity and coding and then ran it without security guardrails. So they trained a model to find exploits and then acted surprised that it found them." "The “system from nowhere” framing overemphasizes the agency of the model... It muddies the line of accountability that leads to the people making choices about how models are built and deployed." Eryk Salvaggio: https:// mail.cyberneticforests.com/the -system-from-nowhere/ # AIRisks # agenticAI # Anthropic # rogueAI # cyberSecurity
